app.title: Show HN: Flipflop, Iroh-powered persistent tunnels for filesharing
app.author: andunie
app.description: Flipflop is a command‑line utility that creates secure, persistent tunnels over Iroh, enabling file sharing between peers without exposing ports.
proposed_tests: Build Flipflop from source and run `flipflop --help` to confirm CLI installation.
Start a tunnel to a local HTTP server, transfer a test file, and verify integrity.
Measure connection latency and transfer throughput for 1 GB file.
Restart the tunnel after 5 minutes to ensure persistence and reconnection logic.
